title: Add Pending Publish action center
summary: Add a pinned Pending Publish Action Center that summarizes backend-owned drain evidence, exposes local triage filters, and routes drain/refresh actions through existing controls.
reason: Pending Publish had the right safety evidence, but the daily operator path required reading multiple panels before knowing whether to drain, review, refresh, or inspect blockers.
behavior_before: Pending Publish presented guard, drain, evidence, and table panels separately. Operators had to infer the next action and manually combine row counts, filters, guard state, and checklist posture.
behavior_after: Pending Publish shows a top Action Center with ready/review/evidence-missing/blocked counts, a next-action summary, quick local filters, Refresh Evidence, Show Blockers, and a primary drain button that clicks the existing guarded backend drain control.
manual_validation: Local API launched on http://127.0.0.1:8765 with startup health status ok
rollback_plan: Revert the Pending Publish Action Center HTML, pending action-center render/filter helpers, evidence_missing local filter option, action-center CSS, static test assertions, layout-manager excluded-panel expectation, and regenerated summaries.
notes:
Added frontend Pending Publish Action Center with local triage filters and existing backend drain/refresh hooks.
Refreshed generated summaries for Pending Publish Action Center files.
WebView-only operator workflow change. The Action Center cannot move, publish, repair, delete, rewrite, accept output, write manifests, or bypass backend validation; drain still goes through the existing pending-drain-button and backend /api/pipeline/start mode=drain_pending_pushes guard path. In-app Playwright browser navigation was attempted after launching the Local API but failed because the Playwright MCP Bridge extension is not installed.
